title: 22 - Fallout
summary: Banished by the council of the [[species:delta-eridani-natives|Deltans]], [[character:bob-replicant]] meets [[character:archimedes]] in secret through a camouflaged drone. He has killed six hippogriffs heading for the village since then, but warns that the [[event:destruction-of-the-hippogriff-island|island strike]] wiped out only the local nest, leaving the area unclaimed hippogriff territory; he urges a stock of spare spears and coaches Archimedes on a laminated bow, whose arrows Archimedes passes off as small spears for Buster, a cub of his family. Archimedes is still shunned and other cubs have begun teasing Buster; after they talk over new weapons, ideas for the medicine woman and basic math, he heads back to [[location:camelot]]. Later [[character:marvin]] tells Bob he will soon leave [[location:delta-eridani]], arguing that the Deltans now need only a caretaker and are better off deciding their own destiny without a sky god, and that [[technology:subspace-communications|SCUT]] will keep them in touch. Bob, who had been thinking the same, agrees, worries about the long-silent Luke and Bender, and resolves to shake off a bad year.
